headline: Youssef Nader moves into ARC-2 gold places at 11th

sections.text: Youssef Nader moved from 18th to 11th, gaining 8.48 points to reach 70.56 and enter the 16 gold places.
The gold cutoff rose 1.25 in the past day to 65.97. ibyyue is first outside gold, 17th at 65.56 and 0.41 short.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
